notes: Access: curl_cffi TLS impersonation past Akamai (per prior notes). Unprotected assets/sitemap-plp.xml (1877 URLs, full listing-page tree) fetched successfully with impersonate=chrome99, and assets/sitemap-supercategory-and-spategory.xml (176 hub URLs) with the same profile - searched both for pet/dog/cat keywords. Also fetched the homepage nav HTML and grepped for 'pet'. Only one Pet Care category exists on the whole site: /decorating-and-accessories/pet-accessories/1 ('Pet Accessories'), which sits under the Home Accessories branch (breadcrumb: Home > Home Accessories) with no pet-specific parent group and no Pet Care sibling categories - no Dog/Cat/Pets department, no separate Pet Beds/Pet Bowls/Pet Toys/Pet Travel leaves. Sitemap search for leash|collar|kennel|scratch|litter|paw|puppy|kitten|chew-toy|dog-bed|cat-bed|pet-bed|pet-bowl|pet-food|pet-toy returned zero additional URLs, confirming absence of a broader pet assortment beyond this one page. 'furniture/pet-friendly-upholstery' and 'furniture/petrie-collection' (found in the same sitemap keyword scan) are excluded: pet-friendly-upholstery is stain-resistant fabric furniture (not a pet product), and Petrie/Petite/Petrie-leather-sectional are unrelated furniture-line names containing the substring 'pet'. qty=19 for Pet Accessories verified two ways on the fetched PLP HTML: container attribute data-num-results="19" (data-filter-name=group_id, data-filter-value=18725), and an exact count of 19 unique productId entries in the page's embedded product data (page size is 100 per prior-pass notes, so 19<100 is a full single-page exhaustion, not a partial page). Spot-checked product names behind those 19 productIds (e.g. 'Piazza Tufted Dog Beds', 'Simplehuman Extra Large Pet Food Cans', 'Yamazaki Tall Pet Food Bowls', 'Dupree II Airline Carry-on Pet Car Seat', 'Crispin Impact-Tested Pet Travel Crate', 'Pet Throw Blanket') - all genuine pet-use products (dog beds, feeders/bowls, food storage canisters, travel carrier/crate/car seat, pet blanket), none are pet-themed-for-humans, pet food/consumables, or medical/veterinary, so no MANUAL REVIEW flag applies.
